Ava (sec-eng): @Jenn quick sync—what exact RBAC and KMS artifacts do you need scoped for rw-prod?
Jenn (auditor): Hi—12 months RBAC change history with signed commit SHAs, deployment timestamps, K8s rolebinding snapshots, and KMS rotation + decrypt events for alias/redwood-*. Also a control_map linking artifacts to SOC2/ISO IDs.
Ava (sec-eng): We'll include git commits (infra repo), CI logs, k8s snapshots (with SHA256 manifests), CloudTrail exports for IAM/KMS, and a control_map.csv + control_map.json.
Kai (infra): KMS metadata drafts live in s3://redwood-evidence/kms-metadata/2024-*/. I can produce a JSON bundle and a CSV summary. Sample CSV row: alias,key_id,rotate_enabled,rotation_dates,decrypt_count,last_decrypt_at
Marcus (oncall): Note: emergency rotation for a service account on 2024-07-11 required manual approval—I'll flag it and attach incident RW-INC-211.
Jenn (auditor): Mark exceptions and attach IR ticket. For decrypts we need principal ARNs, event timestamps, and linkage to deployments or incidents.
Ava (sec-eng): We'll include a vuln-triage.md for a stale privileged role and mitigation timeline, plus a third_party_controls.md enumerating vendor-managed controls.
Kai (infra): Repro queries I'll add: aws cloudtrail lookup-events for kms.amazonaws.com and IAM role resources; Splunk example: index=cloudtrail eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com | table _time,eventName,userIdentity.arn
Jenn (auditor): Good. Prefer JSON bundles and a CSV mapping table. Also include verification steps (sha256sum commands) for snapshots.
OpsBot: Ticket RW-EVID-402 created; draft bundle staged at s3://redwood-evidence/drafts/RW-EVID-402/ (presigned link expires in 7 days).
Ava (sec-eng): ETA: full bundle + control_map by EOD tomorrow. Follow-up review call once you scan it?
Jenn (auditor): EOD works. We'll review and send gap list. Thanks all.
